epi_both.note: both contact faces, joined by a spacer in place of the antigen residues between them, which make no contact

epi_core_ext2.note: contact face plus 2 residues of antigen each side, 4 cysteines

epi_core_ext4.note: contact face plus 4 residues of antigen each side, 4 cysteines

epi_core_half.note: leading half of the face: right residues, not enough of them

epi_core_noCys.note: cysteines substituted to serine, which removes the disulfide holding the face in shape and changes nothing else

epi_core_scram.note: the face shuffled, seed 42: same composition, same length, no order

epi_face2.note: second contact face, around a hotspot burying 43 A2

epi_sub01.note: contact face with its hotspots and cysteines held, and the other 6 positions conservatively substituted

epi_sub02.note: contact face with its hotspots and cysteines held, and the other 6 positions conservatively substituted

epi_sub03.note: contact face with its hotspots and cysteines held, and the other 6 positions conservatively substituted

polyG.note: no designed interaction, matched to the face at 12 residues
